assessment.conclusion: IE:285 carries the same use-3 relations, host-retained origin, four field groups, available-or-not inventory binding, symbol-inventory and candidate-producer exclusions, language-provider mirror and exact membership predicate as accepted r8 item 9. The IDS note summarizes the same restricted third use and field set; IE retains the explicit bound. No wider producer, symbol census, cache, grammar or import authority is granted.

The two five-field supersessions name CRC-1's exact earlier selected record, the same IE parent and integer line selectors 285 then 1377. Each before is byte-identical to its current CRC-1 after. SYN-1F is the last complete IDS copy in the 98-record chain and is accepted through its binding at index 90. Its two strings already carry CRC-1's after in place and have no selected pointer override, so plain JSON Pointer overrides on this copy are correct. I1-L's older copy is left untouched.

IE detector/adapter bullets, projection/manifest/recognition/retention text and closing historical paragraph survive verbatim except the CRC-2 heading attribution. The two-use provider sentences are rewritten to admit the bounded third use rather than contradicted by an append. IE:1377 and IDS selectionLaw differ only in CRC-2 attribution and the same requested-inventory OR clause. The IDS note's other text survives. Only those two IDS string pointers are overridden; schema shapes, byField, kinds, domains, recipes and other selected passages stay intact. PASSAGES.md exactly reproduces all eight before/after strings.

Static inspection of all 98 selected contract record pins finds CRC-1 at index 82 still current for both IE selectors and no record touching either SYN-1F pointer. Both parents are accepted members; all six subject paths are unused and the five candidates exactly cover the subject minus its record. The unchanged pinned verifier accepts this form with an accepting review carrying the exact ordered target list and a valid four-pin root-assented binding. No selected passage conflict remains. Actual binding remains lead work after M3-C r8 acceptance.

All three evidence scripts were read, not executed. The builder's explicit replacements match the inspected passages; the check script compares selected pins and survival rather than changing verifier rules. The scratch script loads the real worktree verifier unchanged, overlays exact scratch pins only, and retains real pin reads for the candidate and baseline. The pinned report matches the captured revision, lock, record, manifest and target list, and reports the specified passing and refusal cases. These are lead-run results. No further design-unit finding or observation.
